variants.headline: Party leader blunders in election debate
variants.body: A party leader has blundered in an election debate. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: A debate brings a leader's misstep
variants.body: An election debate has included a blunder by a party leader. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: Election argument meets an awkward moment
variants.body: A party leader has made a misstep in an election debate. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.
